section.heading: Requirements for high-quality instructional materials.

para.text: Beginning October 31, 2026, and by October 31 of each year thereafter, each LEA shall provide OSSE with:
The name of the Tier 1 mathematics curricula in use by each school in the LEA, disaggregated by school and grade or grade band within each school; and
Other information OSSE requests related to mathematics instruction, data, and HQIM.

By no later than December 15, 2026, and by December 15 of each year thereafter, OSSE shall publish the Tier 1 mathematics curricula in use by each LEA on its website, disaggregated by school and grade or grade band within each school.
